name: Fifth Third
notes: Shared lockup "Fifth Third + ArtsWave 100 years" (one image). VisitCincy: "Presented by ArtsWave and Fifth Third". CityBeat: ArtsWave launches CAW "in partnership with Fifth Third".

name: ArtsWave
notes: Shared lockup "Fifth Third + ArtsWave 100 years" (one image). ArtsWave centennial logo (AW100) is also in the sponsors page media library (unplaced). ArtsWave's CEO Alecia Kintner: "We're proud to sponsor both Cincinnati Art Week and BLINK this year" (CityBeat).

notes: Identified from the logo artwork (file name is a hash).

notes: Identified from the logo artwork (file name is a hash).

name: Kinley Cincinnati
notes: Hosts the weekly Art Week Happy Hour (The Exchange lobby bar).

name: Urban Sites
notes: Also a storefront/developer partner (CityBeat, Cincinnati Magazine, Threads post tags @urbansites).

name: Cincy Nice
notes: "Cincinnati Art Week is a project of Cincy Nice in partnership with No Standing" (footer). Legal: Cincy Nice Social House, LLC. Cultural Strategy & Civic Experience Studio, Walnut Hills. Instagram @cincynice. Organizer of the NO GRID Eventbrite listing.
about: Cincy Nice is a Cultural Strategy & Civic Experience Studio based in Cincinnati, Ohio.

name: No Standing
notes: Event production studio founded by Megyn Norbut; full production for BLINK 2022 and 2024. Deck calls it "No Standing Only Dancing". Instagram @nostandingstudio.
about: No Standing is an event production studio on a mission to move people through powerful art-based experiences.

name: 3CDC (Cincinnati Center City Development Corp.)
notes: Named by CityBeat and Cincinnati Magazine as a storefront partner; tagged (@3cdc_official) in the @cincinnatiartweek Threads post about available OTR storefronts. No logo on the CAW site.

name: Model Group
notes: CityBeat: storefronts "through a partnership with developers 3CDC, Urban Sites and Model Group". No logo on the CAW site.

name: Meaningful Connections LLC
notes: Tiffany Cooper and Candra Reeves (Meaningful Connections) — Community Impact Advisor.
